args.title: Improve accessibility for error toasts by announcing immediately and not auto-dismissing
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Change the live region role and aria-live attribute so error toasts are announced immediately instead of politely. Alter the auto-dismiss logic to prevent error toasts from disappearing automatically after five seconds, requiring manual dismissal instead. This enhances accessibility by ensuring error messages are promptly announced and remain visible until dismissed, helping slow users not miss the message.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

This file controls the toast notifications, including live regions and auto-dismiss timing. It currently sets all toasts as polite live regions and auto-dismisses them after five seconds. The proposed change is to announce error toasts immediately and keep them visible until dismissed, fixing the accessibility issue reported.
